subject: Red-team report and evidence handoff for SOC 2 / SIG upload
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <e.zhao@cloudwave.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: grc-portal@cloudwave.com, security@cloudwave.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for red-team / penetration test artifacts for SOC 2 & SIG

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Our compliance team is finalizing the SOC 2 evidence bundle and SIG questionnaire for our upcoming audit window.

Can you provide the latest penetration test report (red-team summary is fine) plus a CSV mapping that ties each finding to the SIG/CSP section where it was addressed? The GRC portal requires the report PDF and a findings mapping artifact.

We need the artifacts uploaded into our portal (portal link below) by EOD Tuesday 11/17 if possible. If there are privileged findings that need redaction, please flag those and provide the redacted copy plus a summary of redaction rationale.

GRC portal: https://grc.cloudwave.com/portal/records/CLW-7892
Contact for uploads: grc-portal@cloudwave.com

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Emily Zhao
Security & Compliance Lead
CloudWave Systems
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request for red-team / penetration test artifacts for SOC 2 & SIG

Team — forwarding CloudWave's request. Deadline: EOD Tue 11/17. Key asks: full report PDF, findings->SIG mapping CSV, and redacted copy if needed.

Jonas: can you confirm whether the red-team report contains customer-identifying screenshots or logs that need redacting? If yes, we should prepare a redaction checklist and a redacted PDF.

Mina: if we provide the artifacts, can you handle the GRC portal upload and ensure metadata (report version, redaction notes) are set?

Karthik / Marissa: please loop in the AE/CS contact on CloudWave (Emily) if we need extensions or to clarify scope. Keep me looped.

I'll start pulling the latest red-team bundle and a mapping export.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for red-team / penetration test artifacts for SOC 2 & SIG

Vanessa / Mina — quick update from the ops side.

I reviewed the Nov 2026 red-team report. It contains three sections that reference customer data in screenshots and a single appendix with reversible artifact names from a pre-production log capture. Proposed approach:
- Create a redacted PDF (remove screenshots and mask log identifiers)
- Produce a separate immutable appendix (internal) with original artifacts for auditors only; we can provide a summary and attest to availability under NDA — CloudWave doesn't need the raw appendix in portal.
- Produce a CSV mapping (attached) mapping each finding ID -> SIG control (v2.1) -> remediation status -> ticket link.

Attach: pt-findings-mapping-CloudWave.csv (stub)

Mina — once I hand you the redacted PDF and CSV, please upload to CloudWave's portal and set description to: "Redwood Inference: Redacted Red-team Report (Nov 2026) — mapping attached". In portal comments, call out that raw artifacts are available to auditors under NDA.

If CloudWave insists on raw artifacts in the portal, we should escalate to legal.

—Jonas Weber
Director, Security Operations
From: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for red-team / penetration test artifacts for SOC 2 & SIG

All — I can do the portal upload tomorrow morning. I attached a short instructions stub for the GRC portal and a draft of the upload comment.

Upload checklist:
- File: redacted-redteam-report-20261115.pdf (PDF, ~2.4MB)
- File: pt-findings-mapping-CloudWave.csv (CSV, ~12KB)
- Fill metadata: report_date=2026-11-15, report_type=red-team, redaction_notes=see comment
- Comment: "Redwood Inference has redacted customer-identifying screenshots and masked log identifiers. Raw artifacts are available for auditor review under NDA; contact security@redwood.ai to coordinate."

I will set visibility to "GRC reviewers + CloudWave governance" per their portal options. Scheduling upload for Tue 11/17 09:00 PT. If CloudWave needs it earlier, ping me.

Attach: grc-upload-instructions.txt (stub)

—Mina Haddad
GRC Operations, Redwood Inference
